diagnosticModules.name: Real User Monitoring (RUM) Telemetry
diagnosticModules.recommendedFix:
<!-- 1KB Lightweight RUM CWV Telemetry Script -->
<script>
new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
  for (const entry of list.getEntries()) {
    navigator.sendBeacon("/api/rum", JSON.stringify({ metric: entry.name, val: entry.startTime || entry.duration }));
  }
}).observe({ type: "largest-contentful-paint", buffered: true });
</script>
